request.text_prompt: Create original cold cinematic science-fiction game audio, approximately 0.8 seconds. Mission time-threshold cue, concise and attention-getting without panic. Sixty seconds: two measured low electronic chimes separated by a short pause. One self-contained event or specified short sequence; clear attack, natural decay, quiet clean tail; no abrupt truncation or long dead air. No vocals, singing, humming, speech, narration, lyrics or spoken prompt. No clipping, harsh distortion or unrelated scene sounds. No music, melody or soundtrack.
